question: In solar panel, energy conversion is from _______ to __________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Solar, electrical.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Solar energy** is the energy from the sun that is captured by **solar panels** and converted into** electrical energy.**
 
• The process of energy conversion in a solar panel involves** photovoltaic cells **that absorb sunlight and **release electrons,** which are then captured as electrical energy.
 
• Electrical energy is the form of energy that can be used to **power homes, buildings**, and other **electrical devices.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solar energy** is a **renewable source** of energy that is becoming increasingly popular as a way to **reduce reliance on fossil fuels.**
 
• **Electrical energy** is a versatile form of energy that can be used for a wide range of applications, from** powering homes and businesses** to charging electric vehicles.
 
• **Heat energy** can be used for** heating buildings and water.**
 
• **Light energy** is a form of **electromagnetic radiation** that includes visible light, ultraviolet light, and infrared radiation.
 
• It is used in a wide range of applications, from **lighting to communication** technologies.
